description: Phase 5 final monthly prediction results — 19 test months (2024-05 to 2025-12)
model: Ridge+XGB blend (2-grid ERA5, log_tp, seasonal harmonics, lag-1)

features.era5_features: log_tp (2) + mean ERA5 variables (16) = 18 ERA5 features

pasir_kemudi.note: ERA5 spatial mismatch for Aug-2024 event limits achievable R2. Higher-res input (IMERG 0.1deg) needed.

sg_belat.note: Dual-grid ERA5 improves by +13.8pp over Phase 4.

sg_cherating.note: R2=81.7% exceeds the R2>=0.80 client target. First time target exceeded in this project.

tcn_backbone_results.note: TCN backbone pre-trained on pooled 261 samples (5 stations). TCN+Ridge head underperforms standalone Ridge on this dataset size.
